name: Buran
tagline: Browse the small, calm Gemini internet
description:
The Gemini protocol is a small, calm corner of the internet, simpler and lighter than the modern web, with no ads, trackers, or heavy pages. Buran is a browser for exploring it from your Android phone.

It's a lightweight way to read Gemini pages ('capsules') on the go, for anyone curious about a quieter alternative to regular web browsing.
